The '''TIE/wi Interceptor''', also known as the '''TIE whisper Interceptor''', was a [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]] [[starfighter]] that was used by the [[First Order]], which was similar in design to the [[TIE/wi interceptor]]. It was also similar to the [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]] employed by the same government, although the TIE whisper starfighter had upgraded stealth systems. The TIE whisper had a crew of two, a pilot and a gunner.<ref name="TROS VD" />

The starfighter had two laser cannons under the cockpit. It was the latest in the TIE line, and was a very advanced starfighter.<ref name="TROS VD" /> It also had a [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="Episode IX" /> The whisper saw use during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the First Order and the [[Resistance]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

The TIE whisper starfighter boasted an enhanced stealth and hyperdrive system,<ref name="TROS VD" /> which enabled it to chase the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' after it [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|fled]] the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]].<ref name="Episode IX" />
